task_instruction: slowly lift up the bar, move to top center of the wooden plate, and slowly tap the plate up and down two times.

controlled_entity.description: Upright silver cylindrical bar with a black lower tip.

target_entity.description: Round tan wooden plate lying flat on the table.

axis_constraints.reference_positive_end_description: Rounded silver upper end at phase entry.

phases.name: Lower to the plate center and tap up and down twice

axis_constraints.controlled_positive_end_description: Rounded silver upper end, opposite the black tapping tip.
axis_constraints.reference_positive_end_description: Outward from the plate's exposed top surface.
